gov_aud_f1.design: Four-part defense. (1) classify_field is total and fail-closed: broad governance substring net over the FULL dotted path first, tight exact-name inert allowlist over the leaf second, everything else UNKNOWN and REJECTED. (2) Governance fields are compared PER DOCUMENT ROLE, where the role is derived from the path basename through a closed injective table — cross-role movement fails, role-preserving relocation passes. (3) Within a role the comparison key is a TUPLE (role, field), never a concatenated string, so no crafted field name shares its namespace. (4) Structural conjuncts must rest on an OBSERVED_GIT basis; a caller attestation cannot carry a PASS.
gov_aud_f1.conjunct_completeness: All 8 verbatim conjuncts of §08 WHEN_PROOF_ONLY_SUCCESSOR_IS_SUFFICIENT are implemented: six observed structural facts, the seventh (no_new_finding_or_acceptance_criterion) as the role-scoped semantic comparison, and the eighth (equivalence_validator_passes) as the conjunction itself. raw_diff_contains_no_substantive_source_change is DERIVED from path membership and tree equality rather than attested — the attestation was one of the audit's findings.

GOV-AUD-001.finding: ProofOnlySuccessorEquivalence permitted governance laundering BETWEEN documents. The aggregate discarded document provenance and counted values bundle-wide, so a risk could be removed from the document the operator and PR Steward read and re-encoded in one with no authority. A checked-in positive test REQUIRED that swap to pass.
GOV-AUD-001.fix: Assertions are keyed by a TUPLE (document_role, field_name) — never a concatenated string, so no crafted field name shares its namespace. document_role is DERIVED from the path basename via a closed table; an unlisted basename yields UNKNOWN and is rejected, and a caller-declared role contradicting the derivation is rejected.
GOV-AUD-001.granularity_decision: The table is INJECTIVE — one role per document kind, 23 roles. An initial draft grouped AUDITOR_REPORT.md, AUDIT.md, AGY_AUDIT.md and AUDITOR_REPAIR_REPORT.md under one AUDIT_RESULT role on the theory that same-role documents are interchangeable carriers. Adversarial probing showed a swap between two such documents PASSED, which is this same finding at finer grain for any consumer reading only one of them. Architecture §08 rules genuinely ambiguous semantic status substantive, so grouping was refused. Splitting can only reject more; it can never admit a change grouping would have caught.
GOV-AUD-001.relocation_preserved: Relocation preserves the basename, so proof/A/PROOF.json -> proof/B/PROOF.json keeps the PROOF_BUNDLE role and still passes, satisfying the architecture's required relocation control.
GOV-AUD-001.blessed_test_flipped: test_content_exchanged_between_documents_preserves_the_aggregate (which asserted the swap PASSES) is deleted; TestCrossRoleLaundering now asserts the same moves FAIL.
GOV-AUD-001.verified_by: TestCrossRoleLaundering (6 fixtures), TestDocumentRoleDerivation (12 fixtures incl. an injectivity assertion), TestAggregateForgery (5 fixtures)

GOV-AUD-002.finding: Several conjuncts were merely caller attestations. ancestry_basis=CLAIMED_INPUT was accepted, and the CLI fed arbitrary JSON booleans for ancestry, changed paths, tree equivalence, raw-diff safety and every digest straight into the evaluator, so a caller could manufacture a PASS the evaluator never established.
GOV-AUD-002.fix: Each of the six structural conjuncts of §08 carries a FactBasis (OBSERVED_GIT / CLAIMED_INPUT / UNKNOWN). Only OBSERVED_GIT supports a PASS; anything else emits conjunct_not_observed:<name>. Facts come from snapshot.observe_proof_only_facts, a deterministic observer reading git through a SHAPE-validated read-only allowlist. raw_diff_contains_no_substantive_source_change is REMOVED as an attestation and DERIVED from path membership AND tree equality under exclusion. Absent-on-both digests are an unmade comparison, not 'unchanged'.
GOV-AUD-002.trust_boundary: Stated narrowly and without overclaim: the evaluator performs no I/O, the operator-facing CLI cannot fabricate an OBSERVED_GIT basis (without --repo-root it records CLAIMED_INPUT and cannot pass), and the receipt carries observer_version plus an observation_digest so a later auditor RE-RUNS the observer and compares rather than trusting the receipt. An in-process caller can still construct StructuralFacts labelled OBSERVED_GIT; this is documented in contract.md rather than papered over. Cryptographic attestation is out of scope for G0.
GOV-AUD-002.verified_by: TestClaimedFactsCannotPass (6 fixtures), TestStructuralConjuncts (11 fixtures), TestGitObserver (11 fixtures against a real scratch repository)

GOV-AUD-003.finding: derive_posture returned READY whenever no blockers were supplied and audit_acceptable was True; omitted required gates were never synthesized as UNKNOWN. derive_phase advanced to the highest phase of ANY satisfied gate regardless of missing predecessors. Tests blessed READY from AUDIT+VALIDATION alone and REVIEW from a partial ledger.
GOV-AUD-003.fix: GateLedger carries architecture §05's policy.required_gate_set, defaulting to ALL 15 gate classes. A required class with no entry is materialized as a synthetic GateState.UNKNOWN entry — §05 defines UNKNOWN as 'required evidence is missing' — which is a hard blocker and prevents READY. derive_phase advances only through the longest contiguous satisfied prefix. states_by_class reports the most-blocking state so a satisfied duplicate cannot mask an unsatisfied one.
GOV-AUD-003.blessed_tests_flipped: test_ready_requires_clean_evidence_and_accepted_audit now requires a COMPLETE ledger; test_phase_advances_with_satisfied_gates is replaced by prefix-semantics tests. New negatives assert a partial ledger and a no-ledger snapshot both reach BLOCKED, not READY.
GOV-AUD-003.verified_by: TestRequiredGates (5 fixtures), TestPhase (8 fixtures incl. a 6-way parametrized state sweep), TestPosture (8 fixtures)

GOV-AUD-004.finding: Identity matching was fail-closed only when both sides supplied a dimension; absence was explicitly treated as compatible, so a fully bound identity accepted a project/repo-only one and there was no mechanical way to enforce the packet's worktree/workspace/instance binding rule.
GOV-AUD-004.fix: Identity.missing_dimensions plus require_compatible(required_dimensions=...) deny when a required dimension is unbound on EITHER side. Profile precedence: operator --require-identity-dimension flags, then the packet's declared repo_binding.required_identity_dimensions, then inference from what the expected identity binds. Declaration outranks inference deliberately, because inference is weakest exactly when a caller supplies a sparse expected identity. Wired into GovernedDeliveryEnvelope evidence checks, receipts.require_identity_match and snapshot.build_projection.
GOV-AUD-004.blessed_test_narrowed: test_absent_dimension_is_not_a_conflict is renamed test_absent_dimension_is_not_a_value_conflict and now only asserts that absence is not a VALUE MISMATCH; whether absence is acceptable is a separate, explicitly tested question.

defects_found_by_adversarial_probing_dur.defect: The excluded-content-tree digest hashed only (path, blob oid). Two real changes preserve the blob oid EXACTLY while altering what a file is: a permission change (100644 -> 100755, making a source file executable) and a type change (100644 -> 120000, retyping a regular file whose content is a path into a symlink pointing at it — git stores the symlink target as the blob body, so the oid is byte-identical). Both were reproduced in a scratch repository and confirmed to leave the digest unchanged.
defects_found_by_adversarial_probing_dur.impact_assessment: The path-membership conjunct independently catches both, so no PASS was actually reachable. But these are meant to be INDEPENDENT conjuncts, and a conjunct that silently agrees with its neighbour is not one — the audit's whole theme is not relying on a single predicate.
